text: Do not instruct the user to check their payment requests without confirming the payment request was sent.
applies_when: The agent has not sent a payment request to the user.

text: Do not instruct the user to lift a line suspension if the line's contract end date is in the past.
applies_when: The user has paid all overdue bills but the line's contract end date is in the past.

text: Do not instruct the user to change their plan without confirming the line they want to change.
applies_when: The agent does not know which line the user wants to change the plan for.

text: Do not instruct the user to enable data roaming if the line is not roaming enabled.
applies_when: The user is traveling outside their home network and the line is not roaming enabled.

text: Do not instruct the user to reset APN settings without confirming the current APN settings are incorrect.
applies_when: The agent has not checked the APN settings.

text: Do not instruct the user to grant app permissions without confirming the necessary permissions are not granted.
applies_when: The agent has not checked the app permissions.

text: Do not instruct the user to reboot their device without confirming that a change has been made that requires a reboot.
applies_when: The agent has not made a change that requires the user to reboot their device.

text: Instructing the user to check their status bar for service issues is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting service issues.

text: Instructing the user to toggle Airplane Mode is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting service issues.

text: Instructing the user to toggle mobile data is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting mobile data issues.

text: Instructing the user to toggle data saver mode is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting mobile data issues.

text: Instructing the user to disconnect from a VPN is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting mobile data issues.

text: Instructing the user to check their network mode preference is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting mobile data issues.

text: Instructing the user to check their Wi-Fi calling status is allowed but may not be the most effective method.
applies_when: The agent is troubleshooting MMS issues.
